changelog:
- Initial release of the Document Q&A skill.
- Supports answering questions from PDF, DOCX, TXT, and XLSX files.
- Accepts both individual files and entire folders as input.
- Requires the "iyeque-pdf-reader-1.1.0" skill for PDF extraction.
- Provides simple command-line usage instructions and examples.
summary: Answers questions based on the content of uploaded documents (PDF, DOCX, TXT), supporting individual files or entire folders.
